TOOLING BURST FL-1a — fire lane, round 1: cast halo, per-direction release socket, range fizzle (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; Matt 2026-09-16: "pivot to full fire lane until completed with fire"; conductor R-C5-79, defects F-C5-20/21/22 from the PACK v31 8-direction proof). task_id "FL-1a".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4f, T4h, T4p, T4i-r1 and the new row "FL-1a — fire lane round 1 (cast halo · release socket · range fizzle)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (the G1 component: the CastHalo block near `$CastHalo.texture = rest_head`, the release-socket resolution near `cell.get("sockets", [])` / `release_index` / `bolt.global_position = socket`, the facing/direction handling — note the module doc line "Eight directions rotate the selected cell, never mirror its pixels" — and the G1 termination at range), export/effect_kit.py (G1 kit validation, travel_primitives), runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json (canvas 512; cells cast_<dir>: 8 per-frame `sockets` + `release_index` 3 + `measurements`), runs/C-3/cells_v7/cast_*/ (the 8 cast cells' frames — read the release frame per direction to see where the staff tip is), runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json (+ _A), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

FINDINGS (conductor, PACK v31, eight casts of fire_bolt_e1_B from (3760,640), every 2nd frame at 1920×1080, runs/C-5/t3/FL1-fire-8dir-v31/): (F-C5-20) from the cast's first frame until release (≈ f16–f22) a FULL FIRE-HEAD SPRITE hangs at a fixed point ~1.5 BH off the caster (up-left for E, up-right for W/SW/S) — it is `$CastHalo` = the rest head texture at 1.15×, parked at a socket that is not the current frame's staff tip; it reads as a second bolt. (F-C5-21) at release, E/NE/N/NW spawn ahead of the caster, but W, SW and S spawn on the FAR side (behind / above) and the bolt then flies THROUGH the body; sockets_v2 has per-direction rows, and the measured "tip" for several release frames is the staff's NEAR end (e.g. cast_E frame 3 tip x=179 is west of centre for an east-facing cast) — the T3a line detector picked an end without a facing rule; the runtime may also rotate the E cell's socket rather than use the per-direction row (module doc line). (F-C5-22) at range with nothing struck (W) the bolt plays the FULL impact burst — a fire bolt that fizzles at range must not explode.

PART A — CAST HALO (F-C5-20). Replace the CastHalo's texture with a soft GLOW DISC (the existing Glow/Halo material, additive, band-2 tint, radius 0.35 BH, α .6→.9 over the anticipation, 1.15× pulse) that TRACKS THE CURRENT FRAME'S SOCKET every physics frame from the cast's first frame to release; never the head painting. Trace clause: for every anticipation frame the halo node's texture is not the head texture, its drawn size ≤ 0.5 BH, and its position equals that frame's socket (±2 px). Both fire arms and the ice bolt share the component — the change applies to all G1 kits; kit directories stay byte-identical.

PART B — RELEASE SOCKET PER DIRECTION (F-C5-21). (B1) Diagnose which is happening: per-direction socket rows used as-is, or the E row rotated by facing; make the runtime use THAT DIRECTION'S row (`cells.cast_<dir>.sockets[release_index]`, canvas 512 → cell space → world, with the cell's scale and any facing rotation the cells themselves carry — the doc line says cells are rotated, never mirrored; keep that invariant). (B2) Re-derive the 8 release sockets with a FACING RULE: on each cast_<dir> release frame the socket is the staff end FARTHEST along the facing unit vector (E=(1,0), NE=(1,-1)/√2, N=(0,-1) … in cell pixel space, y down); write them into runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json ONLY at `cells.cast_<dir>.sockets[release_index]` (other frames untouched; add `release_socket_rule: "far end along facing (FL-1a)"` per cell) and list before/after per direction. (B3) Trace clause, 8 directions headless from (3760,640): on the release frame the bolt's rear socket lies within 0.4 BH of the derived release socket AND (bolt_pos − keeper_origin)·facing > 0; no frame in which the bolt's head centre is inside the keeper's body rectangle after release.

PART C — RANGE FIZZLE (F-C5-22). New G1 termination option in the spec: `mechanics.termination: "first_contact_or_range"` gains `range_expiry: "fizzle"` (enum fizzle | burst; validate). Fizzle = over 6 frames the head shrinks to 0.5× and erodes (erode 0→1, outside-in), 3 ember shards (the smallest pieces) drift 0.3 s and fade; NO impact burst, NO floor light, NO key states, NO victim tint/hit-stop. Apply `range_expiry: fizzle` to runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (provenance "R-C5-79 F-C5-22") and re-bake fire_bolt_e1_A and _B (only the kit.json field changes; primitives byte-identical); ice_bolt_e2 keeps burst-at-range (its shatter is the spec). Trace clause: a west cast from (3760,640) with no target reaches range and the trace shows fizzle frames, zero burst pieces, zero FloorLight visibility.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-1a/acceptance.json): the three trace clauses with numbers; sockets before/after table; the 15 kits other than the two fire arms byte-identical (the two arms: kit.json only); full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite with the named tests green and remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): halo texture/position clause; the 8-direction release clause; the fizzle clause; sockets_v2 schema (release_socket_rule present on 8 cells); extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any test file except the three named (extend only), any kit except fire_bolt_e1_A / fire_bolt_e1_B kit.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-1a/, runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (named field) and runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json (named entries). Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-1a"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
